comment: Fixed before any C9 run. `map` sends every Gretel label of the train split to one of the seven bench types; `dropped` lists the labels that are not personal data in the DSGVO sense or are secrets rather than identifiers, with the reason. Dropped labels leave gold and predictions alike: a prediction is only scored if it carries one of the seven types.

dropped.company: a company, not a natural person
dropped.date: a generic date (dates of birth have their own label)
dropped.swift_bic_code: identifies a bank, not a person
dropped.bank_routing_number: identifies a bank, not a person
dropped.api_key: a secret, not an identifier of a person
dropped.password: a secret, not an identifier of a person
dropped.account_pin: a secret, not an identifier of a person
dropped.credit_card_security_code: a secret, not an identifier of a person

notes.local_latlng: geo coordinates of a place; location data of a person under Art. 4(1) DSGVO, counted as address
notes.user_name, ipv4, ipv6: online identifiers under Art. 4(1) DSGVO and recital 30, counted as id_number

llm_types.person: Name einer natürlichen Person (Vor- und/oder Nachname)
llm_types.address: Postanschrift oder Standort einer Person (Straße, Hausnummer, Ort, Koordinaten)
llm_types.id_number: Kennnummer einer Person: Steuer-ID, Sozialversicherungsnummer, Kunden- oder Personalnummer, Pass- oder Führerscheinnummer, Benutzername, IP-Adresse
